title: Hadamard Code Generator
text: Generate OVSF code, 1 output; {Code length}, {Code index} sets the row index of OVSF code matrix, {Sample time}, {Samples per frame} sets the number of OVSF chips output, {Output data type} sets the output type and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Code index
params.values: Row index of OVSF code matrix 60 (default) | integer

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Sample time, in seconds 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Samples per frame
params.values: Number of OVSF chips output 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution
